basis.governing_question: Why do property and health claims take too long to settle, and what claims operating model should Atlântico Seguros move to?

sub_questions.question: Where in the settlement process do property and health claims lose time, and why?
What did the 2024 lean program change for motor claims, and what carries over to property and health?
What are current average settlement time and customer satisfaction for property and health claims?
Which claims operating model options fit property and health claims, and how do they compare?
Which option reduces average settlement time while keeping customer satisfaction at least at current levels?
What transition steps move the insurer to that option, and what must the Board decide?

drivers.evidence: the COO and the Head of Claims, and the final answer goes to the Board
property and health claims take too long to settle

work.unit: Interview round with one stakeholder group
Unit diagnosed (interviews, process walk-throughs, workload and cost baseline)

phase_work.why: Interviews with the three groups run together, then both claims lines are diagnosed side by side; within the archetype's 4 to 8 weeks.

work.unit: Target model for the whole organization (structure, roles, governance)
Unit-level design detailed with the unit's leaders

phase_work.why: Target model, both lines together, transition plan and one review run in sequence, so the upper estimate passes the archetype's 6 to 10 weeks.

sizing.levers: Run the stakeholder interviews alongside the unit diagnosis, saving 1 to 2 weeks, and narrow the target model to the claims function.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Measure current settlement time and customer satisfaction, and find where and why property and health claims lose time.

gate.label: Go/no-go on design
gate.decision: Go on to design, and which causes of delay must the target model address?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the target claims operating model and transition for property and health claims, with the report and Board presentation.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the final report and Board presentation for the 15 March 2027 Board?

architect_notes: Length is open; phases are planned to the 19 weeks available, and Design is cut to 10-12 weeks against an estimate of 8-13.
Not covered by the phases: ASF, new guidance on claims-handling response times. Confirm whether it is in scope.
No Handover phase: the Board receives the final report and presentation, so the last gate covers it.
